notes.title: To celebrate the release of the demo, I've created a magical art contest!
notes.notes:
[b]Good News everyone![/b]

The demo "There's No Dinosaurs 2" have [b]been released today  [/b]

You can find it here:


[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2859810/Theres_No_Dinosaurs_2/ ]Steam page[/url][Full release on Steam 20 June & 13 June Nintendo Switch] 


To [b]celebrate the release[/b], I've created a [b]magical art contest[/b]!

Hey, gamer   [b]Let's be creative! [/b]

[b]Art contest giveaway [/b]

[b]Create and submit images with Dino from "There's No Dinosaurs 2" [ a cozy game with hidden objects and retro vibes][/b]

Submit images in the  ⁠⁠qa  channel [url=https://discord.gg/dAjkuyqedd]Discord[/url]

User-created images only (No AI generation. AI competition will be held individually at a later date)
 
Spoiler alert: On Dino 2, there are [b]multiple levels, you can be inspired if you play the demo.[/b] 

[b]This contest will end on 15 June [ 1 week of submission + rest of community vote]

Giveaway $20 Steam Gift Card to the winner
[/b]
everyone is welcome to participate, if you want, don't worry about your talent
